title: Ddakji
tagline: Fold it. Slap it. Flip theirs.
description: A Korean childhood classic with real paper physics. Fold a thick tile, slap it down beside your rival's, and let the wind and the shock tip theirs onto its back. Six rivals, a fold workshop, twelve tile patterns to win and a two-player mode.
howToPlay: Drag on the floor to place the ghost tile where yours will land, just beside theirs.
Set Strength and Twist with the two sliders, then press Throw.
Land near the middle of an edge: the tile lifts, pivots and flips face down.
Too soft only wobbles it; too hard scatters your throw; landing on top pins it.
Win 2 or 3 flips to take the match and the rival's printed tile.
